name: Stabblow
description: Drive the point straight at the opponent's belly from a square stance with the elbow tucked to the ribs.

name: Raised Handguard
description: Turn the flat of the blade across the body to knock an incoming cut wide of the line.

name: Easing Shortspine
description: Slide the rear foot up and the front foot out to cover a handspan of ground without crossing the legs.

name: Quick Pointcap
description: Rap the pommel against the opponent's wrist or ribs while the point stays ready for the next thrust.

name: Hiltcap Stay
description: Sink the point before the knee and hold the blade across the shin line to cover the lower body.

name: Straight Stabtip
description: Jab the point along the inside of the opponent's arm to hit the shoulder before the cut can begin.

name: Digdrop
description: Flick the short edge across the opponent's sword wrist with a snap of the forearm and no wind-up.

name: Sharp Sting
description: Slide the point between a raised arm and the ribs to prick the side where cloth lies thin.

name: Angled Cutedge
description: Catch an incoming blade on the crossguard and twist the wrist to roll it off the line.

name: Stepping Broadleaf
description: Step the lead foot a short pace off the line of attack while the point keeps facing the opponent.

name: Thumbdodge
description: Pivot on the rear heel to turn side-on and shrink the target presented to the opponent.

name: Folded Knobgrip
description: Hold the blade flat along the forearm and raise it before the face to cover against high strikes.

name: Hard Gore
description: Push from the back leg through the hip and shoulder to send a hard thrust into the opponent's chest.

name: Pokedash
description: Land two short stabs in quick order with one pulse of the wrist at the opponent's guard hand.

name: Settled Shortspine
description: Slide the edge down the opponent's blade to its guard and press it aside before returning a stab.

name: Nimble Dig
description: Take half a step with the front foot to enter inside the opponent's reach while holding the guard.

name: Pushing Handguard
description: Shove the opponent's sword arm aside with the open off hand while the blade stays level at the belly.

name: Tippace
description: Step back on the rear foot with the point forward so the opponent cannot follow in without risk.

name: Nickdrop
description: Repeat one tight thrust at a post until the wrist and tendons can place the point without thought.

name: Stubstrike
description: Whip the forearm tendons taut at the end of a thrust so the point lands sharp and withdraws fast.

name: Thumbcowl
description: Roll the wrist outward to bat a thrust off line with the flat and ready the return stab.

name: Pointcap Lid
description: Hold the point steady at throat height so the opponent must break the line before closing in.

name: Upward Stab
description: Crouch under a high cut and stab upward into the belly with the blade held edge down.

name: Backward Cutedge
description: Withdraw the stabbing arm and rear foot together to recover the guard before an answering cut lands.

name: Sudden Stabtip
description: Shift from forward grip to reverse grip mid-motion and stab downward at a low target.

name: Watching Thumbrest
description: Feel the room around the blade by touch and hearing so the stab never strikes a friend.

name: Planted Broadleaf
description: Stand with the feet a shoulder apart and the weight low so the blade can swing from any side.

name: Stingdash
description: Slide the rear foot forward and stab from a crouch to reach a target just beyond arm length.

name: Stubhop
description: Plant the lead foot hard to halt a forward rush and turn the momentum into a straight thrust.

name: Swaying Poke
description: Step in a small arc around the opponent's lead foot to reach the open flank with the point.

name: Tiplid
description: Drop the blade to shin height and sweep aside a low cut before rising to stab.

name: Digwedge
description: Press the opponent's blade down against his thigh with the flat and pin it while the free hand strikes.

name: Narrow Gore
description: Place a slow thrust on a partner's guard to learn the line and distance before any speed is added.

name: Kept Handguard
description: Meet a partner's cut with the flat and return a stab in one smooth motion.

name: Sideways Knobgrip
description: Match a partner's steps forward and back while holding the blade ready at an even distance.

name: Hitching Stubblade
description: Hook the crossguard behind an opponent's blade and pull it off line to open the chest.

name: Solid Thumbrest
description: Brace the flat against the forearm and shove back a heavy cut with the strength of the shoulder.

name: Stabdash
description: Count three beats of tap and slide and stab so the rhythm hides the true moment of the thrust.

name: Judging Cutedge
description: Watch the opponent's shoulders and hips for the first sign of a cut and brace in time.

name: Nickhit
description: Send a thin thread of qi along the blade as the thrust lands so the point bites deeper.

name: Ready Broadleaf
description: Pulse qi into the flat as it meets an incoming cut so the blow glances off cleanly.

name: Stabhop
description: Time one qi pulse to the leading foot so the step covers a full pace in a single beat.

name: Hiltcap Bump
description: Send a quick pulse of qi into the pommel and rap the opponent's hand to loosen the grip.

name: Stubhusk
description: Keep a faint qi flow in the blade so the point stays steady and threatens the opponent's face.

name: Digstrike
description: Draw the sword from the belt and stab forward in the same motion before the opponent sets a guard.

name: Flat Cutedge
description: Slip the blade free along the scabbard mouth and cut across the opponent's forearm on the draw.

name: Tight Pointcap
description: Catch a cut on the half-drawn blade still held against the scabbard and turn it aside.

name: Pokehit
description: Draw the blade in a reverse grip and stab backward at an opponent who has seized the wearer from behind.

name: Light Thumbrest
description: Step clear of a tangled cloak or belt as the blade comes out and turn to face the threat.

name: Stubdash
description: Draw and stab upward from a seated position at a standing opponent's thigh or groin guard.

name: Resting Stabtip
description: Hold the blade ready against the body in sheath-height guard while stepping through a crowd.

name: Turning Knobgrip
description: Twist the blade and wrist out of an opponent's clasp and strike the grabbing arm with the pommel.

name: Hooding Handguard
description: Hold the blade close to the chest with the point high and cover the head and ribs.

name: Sharp Stab
description: Beat aside a cut and answer with a short stab to the forearm before the guard can recover.

name: Fouling Shortspine
description: Nudge the opponent's blade off line with the guard rim and step in on the opened side.

name: Nickdodge
description: Give ground one pace while holding the guard and then close again once the cut has passed.

name: Angled Hiltcap
description: Drop the elbow and angle the blade to turn a low thrust away from the flank.

name: Stingdrop
description: Time a stab at the wrist of an opponent who has overreached and cannot withdraw in time.

name: Firm Stubblade
description: Turn the hip and tighten the grip together so the thrust travels in one line to the target.

name: Forward Sting
description: Hold the breath and release qi into the point at the instant of contact for a sharper stab.

name: Measured Pointcap
description: Let a pulse of qi in the blade confirm the line from point to target before the thrust begins.

name: Pokepace
description: Snap the arm and body back along the thrust line so the point is clear before a counter lands.

name: Open Stab
description: Slide off the line and thrust at an angle into the gap beside the opponent's guard arm.

name: Raised Cutedge
description: Lift the point sharply to flick aside a downward cut and ride the contact into a stab.

name: Leaden Gore
description: Drag the short edge across the opponent's arm as the thrust is withdrawn to open a long shallow cut.

name: Short Stabtip
description: Perform the standard school thrust from a balanced stance with qi laid lightly along the blade.

name: Planted Thumbrest
description: Cross the blade and off hand before the chest to stop a heavy cut with both arms braced.

name: Quick Dig
description: Snap the short edge across the opponent's arm and return to guard before any answering blow.

name: Swaying Knobgrip
description: Turn the shoulders and sway the hip so a thrust passes the ribs and misses the body.

name: Narrow Stabtip
description: Keep the elbow tucked and stab straight ahead in a tight lane where no room exists to swing.

name: Stopping Broadleaf
description: Slap the flat against the opponent's sword hand to jar the fingers and spoil the next cut.

name: Tiphit
description: Step to the outside of the opponent's lead leg and cut the exposed thigh with a short slash.

name: Ready Shortspine
description: Stand in the school's ready posture with qi flowing and the point guarding the centre line.

name: Blunt Poke
description: Pair a single circulation breath with a short jab so qi and steel arrive at the same instant.

name: Stepping Pointcap
description: Shift weight from one foot to the other while the qi stays even and the blade holds its line.

name: Thumbwedge
description: Warm the blade with a gentle qi flow and knock a cut aside with a light turn of the wrist.

name: Low Stab
description: Stab through the gap under the opponent's guard arm after turning the body out of the line.

name: Settled Stubblade
description: Keep slow even breaths and a steady qi hum in the arm while holding the guard against a flurry.

name: Nickstrike
description: Link a feint and a parry and a stab into one short chain of motions that ends with the point.
